d:
After months of going from one thing to the next, I finally had a few days where very little was asked of me. I thought I’d feel relieved, but mostly I felt tired. There were things I’d been carrying for weeks that I only had the space to feel once I slowed down.
I’ve been playing a lot of handpan just for myself lately. I’ll sit down, play for a while, and let my mind wander wherever it needs to go. Some days I stop after a few minutes and go lie down. I’m learning to let that be enough.
